title: Counting the Installments Owed on a Cancelled Repayment Plan (Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery Training Note)
content:
For a reinstatement deposit on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery**, how many installments are counted depends on how the plan failed.

## Rule

- **At least one installment paid, and the shortfall no greater than the default count.** When at least one installment was paid and no more installments are missing than the number of consecutive misses that cancels a plan, only the single latest missed installment is counted: the count is 1.
- **Nothing ever paid.** When no installment was ever paid and at least one plan month has fallen due, every plan month that has fallen due is counted.
- **Every other case.** The installments missed are counted as booked, that is the plan months fallen due less the installments paid.

The number of consecutive misses that cancels a plan is 2 for every debt type: Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606), Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment, Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment, Disability Compensation Overpayment, Veterans Pension Overpayment and Home Loan Guaranty Debt.

## Terms

- **Plan months fallen due** — the whole calendar months from the approval date of the cancelled plan (the latest repayment plan decision on the debt) to the day of the payment; a month counts once the day of the month of the approval date is reached again.
- **Installments paid** — the direct payments received on the debt, each counted as one.
- **Installments missing** — the plan months fallen due less the installments paid.

## Training questions (hypothetical records)

| Plan months fallen due | Installments paid | Missing | Installments counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 3 | 2 — not more than 2 | 1 |
| 5 | 2 | 3 — more than 2 | 3 |
| 4 | 0 | 4 | 4, every month fallen due |
| 6 | 1 | 5 | 5 |

**Why is the count only 1 in the first row?** At least one installment was paid and the 2 missing installments do not exceed the 2 consecutive misses that cancel a plan, so only the latest missed installment is counted.

**What if nothing was paid?** Every plan month that has fallen due is counted.
